main.description: Ends one assistant connected over this appview's MCP server as the account whose session cookie asks: its tokens hold no more, from their next use, and its refresh makes none, so its user would have to sign in again. The last of the account's to go revokes the session the MCP server keeps at its PDS. Answers what is left, as dev.knotless.listSessions does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets, from the pages themselves.
